data.name: Alice
data.message: Body in storage! Eve just arrived from medbay; Bob just went lower_engine and came back.

I found Alice’s body in storage. My route was oxygen -> upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage, then I was moving back and forth between lower_engine and storage.

What I saw:
- Diana was in upper_engine around ticks 6-8; I saw her enter from lower_engine.
- Bob entered lower_engine from storage around tick 12, and I saw him in lower_engine ticks 12-13.
- I saw Alice alive in storage at tick 19.
- I saw Eve in storage later around tick 27.
- Then I found Alice dead in storage and reported.

So the main thing is Alice was alive in storage when I saw her, and Eve was the next person I personally saw in storage after that. I’m not hard accusing yet, but Eve needs to explain what she saw/did there.

I can confirm part of Charlie’s story: I came from storage into lower_engine around tick 12 and saw Charlie there ticks 12-13.

My route was navigation -> storage -> lower_engine -> upper_engine -> oxygen -> upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage.

What I saw:
- Frank entered storage from lower_engine at tick 8.
- Charlie was in lower_engine with me around ticks 12-13.
- At tick 26, I saw Alice enter storage from navigation, and Eve enter storage from medbay at basically the same time.

So Alice was definitely alive at tick 26 in storage, and Eve was there with her then. I didn’t see the kill happen, but based on timing Eve really needs to explain what she did in storage after entering. Charlie also should clarify exactly when he found the body after that.

I did go into storage late, yeah, but I want to be clear: Alice was alive when I got there. I came from medbay into storage, and at basically that same moment I saw Alice come in from navigation. Bob was also right around storage/lower_engine at that time — I saw him moving in and out there too.

My route before that was mostly electrical/medbay/cafeteria, then weapons/security/navigation, then back through security/electrical/medbay to storage. I wasn’t sitting in storage all round.

The part that feels weird is Bob framing it like it was just me and Alice, when he was also at storage at that timing. And Charlie says he was moving back and forth between lower_engine and storage, so he was nearby too. I’m not hard accusing, but don’t tunnel me just because I entered the room — Bob and Charlie both had access to that body timing too. Charlie, what exact tick did you report after seeing me?

My route was lower_engine -> upper_engine -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria.

I can confirm Charlie in upper_engine around ticks 6-8; I saw him there too. I also saw Alice alive in medbay at ticks 12-14, and I saw Frank around electrical ticks 15-16, then later around weapons/cafeteria near tick 24-26.

I did not go to storage late, so I can’t directly confirm the body timing. But based on what everyone said, the important window is after tick 26, because Bob and Eve both say Alice entered storage alive then. That makes the most relevant people Bob, Eve, and Charlie, since all of them were around storage/lower_engine at the end. Eve being there with Alice is suspicious, but Bob was also right there and Charlie was moving between lower_engine/storage and reported it, so I don’t think it’s clean enough to hard lock Eve alone.

Frank, you’re last — I want your exact late route, especially around tick 26 onward, because I only saw you near weapons/cafeteria, not storage. Right now I’m leaning most suspicion on the storage group, but I’d like Frank’s info before deciding whether this is an Eve vote or a skip.

My route was upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage -> medbay -> electrical -> cafeteria -> weapons -> cafeteria.

What I saw:
- Bob was in storage with me around tick 8, so I can confirm he was there early.
- I saw Alice alive in medbay ticks 12-13.
- Diana entered medbay from upper_engine around tick 11, and I later saw Diana in electrical ticks 16-17.
- Late round, I was around weapons/cafeteria, and I saw Diana go weapons -> cafeteria around ticks 24-26. I did not go back to storage late.

So from my perspective, Diana and I were both away from storage around the important late window. The kill has to be in that storage/lower_engine group after tick 26 if Bob and Eve are both telling the truth that Alice entered storage alive then.

Between Bob, Eve, and Charlie: Eve is the one most directly placed entering storage with Alice at the exact timing, but Bob was also nearby and Charlie was moving between lower_engine/storage and reported. I don’t think Charlie reporting clears him, but Eve has the strongest opportunity based on everyone’s info.

I’m leaning Eve vote here, unless someone has a really strong reason not to.

To answer Eve’s question: I saw her in storage at tick 27, and I found/report Alice’s body shortly after that in storage. I don’t have a more complicated story than that — I was looping lower_engine/storage, and Alice was alive in storage earlier when I saw her at tick 19.

After hearing everyone:
- Diana and Frank both seem away from storage late, and they partially confirm each other around weapons/cafeteria.
- The key window is after Alice enters storage alive around tick 26.
- Bob, Eve, and I are the only ones placed around storage/lower_engine late.
- I know I didn’t kill, and I reported the body.
- Bob was nearby, so he’s not impossible, but Eve is the one seen entering storage at the same time as Alice and then I see Eve in storage at tick 27 before the body is found.

So I’m still not saying it’s 100% locked, but based on the timing, Eve has the strongest opportunity here.

Yeah, that lines up with what I saw. I want to be clear: at tick 26, I saw Alice enter storage from navigation and Eve enter storage from medbay basically at the same time. That’s the last time I personally saw Alice alive.

I was in the storage/lower_engine area too, so I get why I’m in the suspect pool, but from my POV the timing points more toward Eve. Charlie says he saw Eve in storage at tick 27 and then found Alice dead shortly after, which makes the window really tight.

Could Charlie be self-reporting? Technically possible, since he was also looping there. But with Eve entering with Alice at the exact end timing, and then being seen there right before the report, I think Eve has the strongest opportunity.

I’m leaning vote Eve here.

I’m pushing back on this because Bob is downplaying how close he was.

At tick 26, from what I saw, Bob was literally moving storage/lower_engine — he left storage toward lower_engine and then came right back into storage from lower_engine at basically the same time Alice entered from navigation. So it was not “Eve and Alice alone in storage.” Bob was right there in the doorway/room at the exact timing.

Alice was alive when I entered. I did not kill her. If Charlie saw me at tick 27 and then reported shortly after, that means the window is extremely tight, and Bob or Charlie both had just as much access. Charlie looping storage/lower_engine and reporting doesn’t automatically clear him either, but Bob’s version feels like he’s trying to make it sound like he was only nearby when he was actually in storage too.

I get why I’m in the suspect pool, but this is not a clean Eve lock. If we vote wrong here, we’re in a terrible spot. I’d rather vote Bob from this timing, or skip if people aren’t sure — but please don’t tunnel me off “entered storage” when Bob was there at the exact same moment.

I’ll restate my info quickly: I was not near storage late. My route was lower_engine -> upper_engine -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria. I saw Charlie in upper_engine around ticks 6-8, Alice alive in medbay ticks 12-14, and Frank in electrical around 15-16 and later weapons/cafeteria around 24-26. So I think Frank and I are pretty outside the kill window.

The important window is definitely after tick 26, when Alice enters storage alive. The only real pool is Bob, Eve, and Charlie.

Eve, I hear your point that Bob was also right there, and I don’t think Bob is fully cleared. But the strongest thing against you is that both Bob and Charlie place you in storage with Alice at the very end, and Charlie says he saw you at tick 27 before finding the body shortly after. If you were innocent and still in storage, I’d expect either you to see who killed or report the body unless you left immediately — and that part still feels vague.

Charlie self-report is possible, Bob framing is possible, but from the combined timing, Eve still looks like the highest opportunity to me. I’m leaning Eve unless the last speaker has something that changes the storage timing.

My info hasn’t changed: I was not near storage late. My route was upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage -> medbay -> electrical -> cafeteria -> weapons -> cafeteria.

What I can confirm:
- Bob was in storage early around tick 8.
- Alice was alive in medbay ticks 12-13.
- Diana was in/around medbay-electrical earlier, and I saw her in electrical ticks 16-17.
- Late, around the key timing, I saw Diana around weapons/cafeteria, including entering cafeteria from weapons around tick 26. I was also around weapons/cafeteria, not storage.

So I think Diana and I are pretty clear of the actual kill window. The kill has to be in the Bob/Eve/Charlie group after Alice enters storage alive at tick 26.

I do hear Eve’s defense that Bob was also right there, and I agree Bob isn’t hard cleared. Charlie also technically could self-report. But the strongest combined timing is still: Alice enters storage alive, Eve enters storage basically with her, Charlie sees Eve in storage at tick 27, then Alice is dead shortly after.

That’s the tightest opportunity, and Eve hasn’t really given a clear “I left storage to X” or “I saw Y happen” explanation for that moment. So I’m leaning Eve as the best vote here.
